name: unknown-property-stripped
description: an undescribed property on a known event is stripped with a warning naming its path, and the event itself survives intact
kill: make stripUnknown pass unknown object keys through instead of removing them (drop the `stripped.push(...); continue;` branch for an undescribed key) — the run still completes, but no warning names the path and the property reaches application code

dotnet.intentional: .NET has no enforcement stage yet; alignment tracked separately. Its converters accept the unknown property silently, drop the data, and warn about nothing — so the observable difference is the absent warning, not the surviving content.
